data.narrative:
Besxar Space Industries is a stealth-exit stage company in Space & Aerospace founded by Ashley Pilipiszyn, former OpenAI Technical Director to the CTO. The valuation universe comprises 6 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs—a total of 14 same-sector datapoints. However, the narrow peer set presents material constraints.

Peer-median triangulation is not applicable due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage matches within the Space & Aerospace cohort; no subset of three or more comparables met tighter stage and valuation-tier filters. Public-comp anchoring cannot be executed absent the target's revenue disclosure, which is standard opacity for private companies. The Space & Aerospace public median trades at 27.4x price-to-sales across the 5 public tickers, but without Besxar's revenue, this multiple cannot be applied to derive an equity value.

The analysis does not yield a triangulated valuation range at this time. Key uncertainties include: (1) target revenue or near-term revenue run rate; (2) stage-specific comparables at stealth-exit with disclosed valuations; and (3) clarity on Besxar's specific product and go-to-market trajectory within the fragmented space sector. Further due diligence on financial metrics and closer peer matching would be required to support a defensible valuation.
